The PC usually finds this phone by name on its own. USB tethering shows up here as a wired address and is the lowest-latency path.
PCs running AudioPush in receive mode
Android lets each app refuse to have its audio captured, and many streaming apps do. Anything that refuses arrives as silence — that is a platform rule, not a bug here.
Audio will stop when the screen goes off

Android is allowed to put this app to sleep, which freezes the stream a minute after you lock the phone. Allowing it to run unrestricted fixes that. It only uses power while you are actually streaming.
